description:
Sweep handle_* docstrings in jmap-sharing-server (sibling propagation of canonical from JMAP-h47t.30.7).

Pattern (per parent JMAP-h47t.30 and template tasks-server):

1. Per-handler rustdoc on every `handle_*` fn:
   - One-line title with type-specific spec ref (RFC 9670 / draft-ietf-jmap-sharing §X.Y).
   - `args` shape + return-`Value` shape paragraph (RFC 8620 §5.x refs).
   - Optional type-specific notes.
   - Trailer: `/// Returns `(response_args, extra_invocations)`. ...`

2. Module-level `# Wire-shape contract` paragraph on every src/*.rs file with handlers.

Files to touch (2 files, 10 handlers): src/notification.rs (5), src/principal.rs (5)

No API break. Pure docs. Verify with `cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-sharing-server`.

Depends on JMAP-h47t.30.7 landing first (canonical-template rule).
